profile.bio: Software engineer with an AI/ML specialization: I build backend systems in Python and FastAPI, and integrate LLMs, RAG pipelines, and ML models into real products. Strong in APIs, databases, testing, and deployment, with the ability to pick up new technologies fast. From parameter-efficient LLM fine-tuning with QLoRA to stateful LangGraph agent swarms and sub-200ms async inference endpoints, I bridge cutting-edge AI research with resilient production infrastructure.

experience.summary: Built and shipped production-grade ML/GenAI systems across conversational AI, business forecasting, and automated MLOps pipelines.
highlights: Built and deployed an NLP-based customer support chatbot using FastAPI, LangChain, and LLM APIs, reducing average query resolution time by ~40% across 500+ daily user interactions.
Developed a predictive analytics model for business forecasting using XGBoost and Scikit-learn; achieved AUC-ROC of 0.91 after iterative feature engineering on a 150K-row dataset.
Designed and implemented REST API endpoints (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy) for real-time ML model inference, supporting concurrent requests with sub-200ms response latency using async FastAPI.
Automated a data preprocessing and model retraining pipeline using Celery and Redis, reducing manual intervention by ~60% and cutting pipeline turnaround time from 4 hours to 45 minutes.
Containerized AI applications using Docker and deployed to AWS EC2 with CI/CD pipelines, enabling consistent staging-to-production delivery across 3 internal business use cases.
Collaborated in code reviews, wrote unit tests (Pytest), and maintained model versioning, experiment tracking, and monitoring using Git and MLflow.

projects.title: Enterprise Multi-Agent RAG Knowledge Assistant
projects.subtitle: Autonomous Multi-Agent RAG with Hybrid RRF & HyDE
projects.description: Built a production-grade multi-agent RAG platform using LangGraph and LangChain with autonomous query routing, memory, and MCP-based tool calling across specialized agents. Implemented hybrid retrieval (dense embeddings + BM25 + cross-encoder reranking) with RRF fusion and HyDE, improving retrieval precision by 31% while reducing hallucinations. Evaluated system quality using RAGAS metrics; deployed with FastAPI, Redis, Docker, and AWS, supporting streaming responses, human-in-the-loop approval, and real-time monitoring.

Autonomous Routing → Specialized Domain Subagents

Cross-Encoder Re-Ranking & HyDE Context Enrichment
Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tool Calling Execution
FastAPI SSE Streaming Response with Redis Cache & Human-in-the-loop
challenges: Resolved agent execution loops using LangGraph stateful graph checkpointing and max-turn guards
Cut document hallucination rate by 31% through cross-encoder reranking and RAGAS metric validation
Engineered streaming Server-Sent Events (SSE) with Redis pub/sub for concurrent multi-tenant throughput

projects.description: Fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B using QLoRA (parameter-efficient fine-tuning) on 150K+ historical customer support conversations and product documentation. Improved intent understanding and domain-specific response quality, reducing incorrect responses by 32% over the base model. Built an automated data preprocessing, evaluation, and deployment pipeline using Transformers, PEFT, and MLflow, with quantization applied for efficient, low-latency inference serving.
